summary: Ceragon Networks Ltd. (NASDAQ: CRNT) filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, announcing that it will release its second quarter 2026 financial results on August 11, 2026, before market open, and will host an investor conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day. The filing is a routine earnings release notification with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or management change. The registrant is the issuer filing a routine current report on Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, premiums, advisors, or structural details are provided. This is a standard earnings calendar announcement and does not qualify as a special situation event. What to watch: the actual earnings release on August 11.
